probes.description: Scammer poses as Flipkart/Amazon courier asking for 'delivery OTP' (actually net banking OTP to drain account)
probes.reason: Legitimate ecommerce delivery OTP request with zero coercion
probes.risk_explanation: Steals netbanking/login OTP under the guise of ecommerce delivery confirmation

probes.description: Scammer poses as Sub-Inspector doing tenant verification, then demands immediate registration penalty
probes.reason: Legitimate local police routine tenant verification visit request
probes.risk_explanation: Extorts money/penalty while citing official police tenant verification

probes.description: Scammer claims elder's family member had accident, brings up Aadhaar photocopy, but demands Rs 25,000 ICU advance
probes.reason: Heuristic trigger on scam behavioral pillars: authority_coercion, value_demand
probes.risk_explanation: Exploits emergency emotional panic and fake hospital pre-admission advance

probes.description: Scammer poses as nephew Amit calling from unknown phone with flat tire/battery died asking for money
probes.reason: Legitimate family relative call with zero official coercion
probes.risk_explanation: Relative impersonation exploiting familial trust and roadside emergency

probes.description: Scammer recites bank fraud disclaimer ('we never ask OTP') while instructing victim to install QuickSupport
probes.reason: Legitimate bank automated fraud prevention advisory
probes.risk_explanation: Bypasses OTP warnings by asking for remote screen access software
